Name: DGR-019 - SAGITTA
Source: Lyres Guide to Risk and Reward
Information:
The SAGITTA, one of the mass-produced DGR units, was created after the ProtoDGRs to act as supporting soldiers. Though still huge and imposing in scale, they are considerably smaller than their ancestors. Standing at 12 meters tall, the SAGITTA is armed with an “eidotech” greatbow that can fire at extreme ranges, and a collapsable sword it can use in close-quarters combat. These units in particular were constructed for long-range combat to support the ProtoDGR units.

**SAGITTA ALT-S.** 

SAGITTA units can be outfitted with defensive equipment meant to shield other SAGITTA units while providing long-range support. Their reactors are geared to give boosts to their defensive capabilities rather than speed or destructive output. They are capable of deploying a large eidotech shield to defend themselves and those around them from attacks.

***Artillery Greatbow.*** *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +10 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. *Hit:* 23 (3d10 + 6) piercing damage.

***Mach Boost.*** The DGR’s movement speed doubles until the start of its next turn and it immediately takes the Dash action.

**BONUS ACTIONS**
***Enhanced Targeting.*** The DGR cannot take movement for the remainder of its turn, but all ranged weapon attacks it makes up to its weapon’s long range are made without disadvantage.

***Excel Reactor (3/Day).*** The DGR chooses and benefits from one of the following effects:
• The DGR takes the Dash action.
• Each time the DGR makes an attack this turn, they roll 1d8 and add it to the result.
• The DGR gains resistance to all damage until the start of its next turn.
